claims.statement: Pinned Projects practice guide spans FPT/GHEC/GHES and supplies tips, not accepted mandatory estate policy. Local adoption must separately identify obligation strength, profile and owner.
Mentions/team mentions communicate, assignment signals responsibility and issue/PR links relate work. Delivery/acknowledgement, authority and correct ownership are not guaranteed by existence.

Decompose large issues for manageable parallel work/smaller PR review; sub-issues, types, explicit blocking dependencies and milestones/labels track relationships. No universal size/team count or dependency enforcement specified.

Project description/README should explain purpose, view use, links/contacts; status updates communicate high-level status/dates. Documentation and author status are not evidence source-to-control gates achieved.

Views support backlog/iteration/roadmap/release perspectives, filters/groups/sort/slice/estimates/board limits. Board limits remain advisory per detailed guide, and estimate sums not measured completed work or verified capacity.

Field types should meet contextual need, with iterations for scheduling/reflection and single-select vocabulary for priority/phase. Preset taxonomy and past iteration display do not prove work acceptance or enforce scheduling.

Automation recommendations reduce manual effort through built-ins/API/Actions, such as closed issue→Done or ready-for-review→needs review. This does not prescribe blanket activation, complete backfill, correct permissions or native receipt.

Charts visualize project-added data but detailed insights omits archived/deleted; sharing with project viewers requires audience review. Template configuration excludes auto-add and includes drafts/insights; template label is not enforced policy or licensed reuse.
Team linkage grants collaborators while same-owner repository linkage lists project. Recommendations do not collapse distinct access effects or authorize grants.

Single source of truth recommends one authoritative target date rather than duplicated fields; automatic issue/PR metadata sync is source capability not measured latency/integrity. Proposed binding should trace authoritative identity and current verified representation.

Complete guide/sub-issue reusable reviewed; no conditional feature or executable agent prompt appears in this pinned page. No upstream instructions executed, native changes, accepted policy or rights clearance.
